    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(15.Agent Runtime：智能体真正的大脑)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="19s19yy" data-start="295" data-end="324">第十五章 Agent Runtime：智能体真正的大脑</h1>
<hr data-start="326" data-end="329">
<h2 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">目录</h2>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<h1 data-section-id="1mmd8h9" data-start="331" data-end="337">本章导读</h1>
<p data-start="339" data-end="353">前面的章节，我们分别介绍了：</p>
<ul data-start="355" data-end="461">
<li data-section-id="zzml6k" data-start="355" data-end="367">LLM——负责思考；</li>
<li data-section-id="1euwzby" data-start="368" data-end="385">Tool——负责执行具体能力；</li>
<li data-section-id="z846uw" data-start="386" data-end="400">MCP——负责连接工具；</li>
<li data-section-id="u8nv6d" data-start="401" data-end="422">Workflow——负责组织固定流程；</li>
<li data-section-id="1wbpl51" data-start="423" data-end="442">Memory——负责保存长期信息；</li>
<li data-section-id="1sgf5cc" data-start="443" data-end="461">Skill——负责封装专业能力。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="463" data-end="477">到这里，又有新的问题出现了。</p>
<p data-start="479" data-end="499">如果把 Agent 比作一家公司的员工。</p>
<p data-start="501" data-end="504">那么：</p>
<p data-start="506" data-end="514">LLM 是大脑。</p>
<p data-start="516" data-end="525">Tool 是双手。</p>
<p data-start="527" data-end="539">Memory 是笔记本。</p>
<p data-start="541" data-end="556">Workflow 是工作流程。</p>
<p data-start="558" data-end="570">Skill 是专业技能。</p>
<p data-start="572" data-end="575"><span data-start="579" data-end="592">那么问题就出现了:&nbsp;</span><strong data-start="579" data-end="592">是谁在安排这一切？</strong></p>
<p data-start="594" data-end="598">谁来负责：</p>
<p data-start="600" data-end="612">什么时候调用 Tool？</p>
<p data-start="614" data-end="628">什么时候读取 Memory？</p>
<p data-start="630" data-end="639">什么时候结束任务？</p>
<p data-start="641" data-end="650">什么时候重新规划？</p>
<p data-start="652" data-end="657">答案就是我们本章要讲解的<strong data-start="661" data-end="687">Agent Runtime（智能体运行时）。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="689" data-end="692">
<h1 data-section-id="1jxfj8y" data-start="694" data-end="718">15.1 什么是 Runtime（运行时）？</h1>
<p data-start="720" data-end="747">很多程序员第一次看到 Runtime 这个词，会想到：</p>
<p data-start="749" data-end="762">Java Runtime。</p>
<p data-start="764" data-end="777">.NET Runtime。</p>
<p data-start="779" data-end="795">Node.js Runtime。</p>
<p data-start="797" data-end="817">这些 Runtime 都有一个共同特点：<strong data-start="821" data-end="838">负责管理程序整个运行过程。</strong></p>
<p data-start="840" data-end="843">例如：</p>
<p data-start="845" data-end="862">.NET Runtime 会负责：</p>
<ul data-start="864" data-end="904">
<li data-section-id="1q3ilqk" data-start="864" data-end="872">加载程序集；</li>
<li data-section-id="1peu9jd" data-start="873" data-end="880">管理内存；</li>
<li data-section-id="1od323q" data-start="881" data-end="888">垃圾回收；</li>
<li data-section-id="ze15j6" data-start="889" data-end="896">调度线程；</li>
<li data-section-id="1ukc7de" data-start="897" data-end="904">捕获异常。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="906" data-end="916">程序真正运行的时候。</p>
<p data-start="918" data-end="928">真正工作的其实不是入口函数&nbsp;<code>Main()</code></p>
<p data-start="950" data-end="953">而是：.NET Runtime。</p>
<hr data-start="970" data-end="973">
<p data-start="975" data-end="986">Agent 也是一样。</p>
<p data-start="988" data-end="992">LLM不会自己运行。</p>
<p data-start="1003" data-end="1008">Tool不会自己调用。</p>
<p data-start="1019" data-end="1026">Memory不会自己搜索。</p>
<p data-start="1037" data-end="1043">Skill也不会自己加载。</p>
<p data-start="1054" data-end="1064">真正协调它们工作的就是：<strong data-start="1071" data-end="1089">Agent Runtime。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1091" data-end="1094">
<h1 data-section-id="1wltzth" data-start="1096" data-end="1124">15.2 Agent Runtime 到底负责什么？</h1>
<p data-start="1126" data-end="1130">我们先一句话总结一下,<strong data-start="1134" data-end="1161">Runtime等于Agent 的总调度中心。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1163" data-end="1167">它负责：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>接收任务
↓
理解目标
↓
制定计划
↓
调用 Skill
↓
调用 Tool
↓
获取结果
↓
继续推理
↓
判断是否结束
↓
输出最终结果</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;整个 Agent 生命周期,其实全部由 Runtime 控制。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="1303" data-end="1306">
<h1 data-section-id="xycvds" data-start="1308" data-end="1331">15.3 Runtime 为什么必须存在？</h1>
<p data-start="1333" data-end="1340">我们还是从例子开始</p>
<p data-start="1342" data-end="1345">用户输入:修复这个 Bug。</p>
<p data-start="1360" data-end="1364">LLM第一步：</p>
<p data-start="1372" data-end="1379">分析 Bug。</p>
<p data-start="1381" data-end="1384">结束。</p>
<p data-start="1386" data-end="1391">那么问题来了。</p>
<p data-start="1393" data-end="1397">怎么继续？</p>
<p data-start="1399" data-end="1408">模型不会自己继续。</p>
<p data-start="1410" data-end="1413">所以这里,Runtime收到模型输出。</p>
<p data-start="1437" data-end="1440">发现需要：<code>Read File</code></p>
<p data-start="1470" data-end="1473">于是调用文件工具。</p>
<p data-start="1487" data-end="1490">得到具体代码文件内容。</p>
<p data-start="1497" data-end="1500">然后继续调用模型。</p>
<p data-start="1509" data-end="1512">模型则继续分析。</p>
<p data-start="1521" data-end="1524">输出：<code>Search Symbol</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>Runtime则继续调用。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1570" data-end="1576">......</p>
<p data-start="1578" data-end="1583">这整个过程模型一直在思考。</p>
<p data-start="1597" data-end="1608">Runtime 则一直在执行。</p>
<p data-start="1615" data-end="1618">因此,真正循环工作的不是LLM。</p>
<p data-start="1641" data-end="1644">而是Runtime。</p>
<hr data-start="1656" data-end="1659">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1o57ul9" data-start="161" data-end="204">15.4 Agent Runtime 的核心机制：事件循环（Event Loop）</h1>
<p data-start="206" data-end="270">前面我们已经知道，Agent Runtime 是整个智能体系统的控制中心。那么，它究竟是如何驱动整个 Agent 持续工作的？</p>
<p data-start="272" data-end="298">答案其实就是 <strong data-start="277" data-end="297">事件循环（Event Loop）</strong>。</p>
<p data-start="300" data-end="369">很多开发者第一次接触 Agent 时，容易认为它只是"连续调用很多次 LLM"。(当然,如果是简单理解 也没毛病)</p>
<p data-start="300" data-end="369">上面我们也讲到了，真正持续运行的并不是大模型，而是 Runtime。</p>
<p data-start="371" data-end="393">我们可以把 Runtime 想象成一位项目经理。</p>
<p data-start="395" data-end="413">它不会亲自完成开发工作，而是不断地：</p>
<ul data-start="415" data-end="491">
<li data-section-id="hn12bx" data-start="415" data-end="428">把任务交给大模型思考；</li>
<li data-section-id="19l7i6k" data-start="429" data-end="442">根据思考结果调用工具；</li>
<li data-section-id="1ocii28" data-start="443" data-end="455">收集工具返回的结果；</li>
<li data-section-id="11se19m" data-start="456" data-end="474">再把新的信息交给大模型继续思考；</li>
<li data-section-id="12y652p" data-start="475" data-end="491">重复这一过程，直到任务完成。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="493" data-end="509">整个过程就像一个不断运行的循环。</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>开始任务
      │
      ▼
加载 Context
      │
      ▼
调用 LLM
      │
      ▼
解析输出
      │
      ▼
是否需要执行 Action？
      │
 ┌────┴────┐
 │         │
否         是
 │         │
 ▼         ▼
结束    调用 Tool
           │
           ▼
    获取 Observation
           │
           ▼
     更新 Context
           │
           └──────────────┐
                          │
                          ▼
                     再次调用 LLM</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="931" data-end="1027">整个过程中，<strong data-start="937" data-end="1027">LLM 并不知道自己处于第几轮推理，也不知道之前执行了哪些工具，它只是不断根据当前的 Context 推理"下一步应该做什么"。真正维护整个执行过程的，是 Runtime。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1029" data-end="1032">
<h2 data-section-id="563dkd" data-start="1034" data-end="1043">举个例子</h2>
<p data-start="1045" data-end="1058">假设用户提出这样一个任务：<strong>帮我分析这个 GitHub 项目的整体架构，并生成一份技术报告。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1096" data-end="1134">Runtime 接收到任务后，不会一次性把所有工作都交给模型，而是逐步完成。</p>
<p data-start="1136" data-end="1153">第一轮，LLM 根据用户目标判断：<strong>我需要先了解项目目录结构。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1172" data-end="1177">于是输出：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div>
<div class="relative">
<div>
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>{
  "action": <span class="ͼk">"list_files",
  "path": <span class="ͼk">"./"
}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1237" data-end="1275">Runtime 识别到这是一个工具调用请求，于是执行文件工具，返回项目目录。</p>
<p data-start="1277" data-end="1297">第二轮，LLM 看到目录结构后，又判断：<strong>需要先阅读 README 文件。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1319" data-end="1326">于是继续输出：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div>
<div class="relative">
<div>
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>{
  "action": <span class="ͼk">"read_file",
  "file": <span class="ͼk">"README.md"
}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1392" data-end="1405">Runtime 再次执行。</p>
<p data-start="1407" data-end="1418">随后模型可能继续要求：</p>
<ul data-start="1420" data-end="1467">
<li data-section-id="1f5vett" data-start="1420" data-end="1436">搜索 Controller；</li>
<li data-section-id="18z03lf" data-start="1437" data-end="1447">查看数据库配置；</li>
<li data-section-id="19xcuyu" data-start="1448" data-end="1457">分析依赖关系；</li>
<li data-section-id="zgwc4k" data-start="1458" data-end="1467">统计模块数量；</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1469" data-end="1476">直到最后输出：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div>
<div class="relative">
<div>
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>{
  "finish": <span class="ͼj">true,
  "answer": <span class="ͼk">"项目整体采用分层架构……"
}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1540" data-end="1586">Runtime 收到 <code data-start="1551" data-end="1564">finish=true</code> 后，结束整个循环，并把最终结果返回给用户。</p>
<p data-start="1588" data-end="1631">可以看到，整个任务实际上经历了几十轮甚至上百轮推理，而不是一次 Prompt 就完成的。</p>
<hr data-start="1633" data-end="1636">
<h2 data-section-id="1bhl8jp" data-start="1638" data-end="1651">为什么不能一次完成？</h2>
<p data-start="1653" data-end="1660">有人可能会问：</p>
<p data-start="1662" data-end="1674">为什么不能一次告诉模型：<strong>"请先分析目录，再分析代码，最后生成报告。"</strong></p>
<p data-start="1702" data-end="1729">原因在于，真实世界的大多数任务都具有<strong data-start="1720" data-end="1728">不确定性</strong>。</p>
<p data-start="1731" data-end="1751">例如，在开始分析项目之前，模型并不知道：</p>
<ul data-start="1753" data-end="1817">
<li data-section-id="1568fmi" data-start="1753" data-end="1764">项目有多少个模块；</li>
<li data-section-id="8k0zot" data-start="1765" data-end="1776">使用什么开发框架；</li>
<li data-section-id="2sq2bs" data-start="1777" data-end="1790">有没有 README；</li>
<li data-section-id="1l8rs2g" data-start="1791" data-end="1802">是否存在配置文件；</li>
<li data-section-id="hjrs5z" data-start="1803" data-end="1817">是否需要查看数据库脚本。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1819" data-end="1837">这些信息都必须在执行过程中逐步获取。</p>
<p data-start="1839" data-end="1862">因此，Agent 的工作方式更像人类解决问题：<strong data-start="1866" data-end="1899">观察环境 → 决定下一步 → 获取反馈 → 再决定下一步。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1901" data-end="1917">而不是提前把所有步骤全部规划好。</p>
<p data-start="1919" data-end="1954">这种动态决策能力，也是 Agent 比传统工作流更加灵活的重要原因。(也是今年Agent这么火的原因之一)</p>
<hr data-start="2151" data-end="2154">
<h1 data-section-id="14dyxf9" data-start="2156" data-end="2195">15.5 Agent 的核心闭环：Action 与 Observation</h1>
<p data-start="2197" data-end="2288">如果说 Event Loop 是 Agent 的运行框架，那么 <strong data-start="2229" data-end="2243">Action（行动）</strong> 与 <strong data-start="2246" data-end="2265">Observation（观察）</strong> 就是 Agent 与现实世界交互的核心机制。</p>
<p data-start="2290" data-end="2308">很多人误以为，大模型会直接调用工具。</p>
<p data-start="2310" data-end="2317">实际上在Agent中,这是错误的。</p>
<p data-start="2319" data-end="2367">LLM 并不会真正执行任何操作，它只负责<strong data-start="2339" data-end="2367">告诉 Runtime："我下一步希望执行什么。"</strong></p>
<p data-start="2369" data-end="2389">真正执行并调用工具的，始终是 Runtime。</p>
<hr data-start="2391" data-end="2394">
<h2 data-section-id="lwju3n" data-start="2396" data-end="2410">什么是 Action？</h2>
<p data-start="2412" data-end="2438">Action 可以理解为模型输出的一条"执行指令"。</p>
<p data-start="2440" data-end="2458">例如，当模型分析代码时，它可能输出：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div>
<div class="relative">
<div>
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>{
  "action": <span class="ͼk">"read_file",
  "path": <span class="ͼk">"Program.cs"
}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2525" data-end="2528">或者：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div>
<div class="relative">
<div>
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>{
  "action": <span class="ͼk">"search_symbol",
  "keyword": <span class="ͼk">"CreateOrder"
}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2603" data-end="2607">再或者：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="relative h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div>
<div class="relative">
<div>
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>{
  "action": <span class="ͼk">"execute_shell",
  "command": <span class="ͼk">"dotnet test"
}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2682" data-end="2695">这些都属于 Action。</p>
<p data-start="2697" data-end="2717">请注意，它们只是模型的<strong data-start="2708" data-end="2716">决策结果,然后需要&nbsp;Runtime去执行后续的动作.</strong></p>
<p data-start="2719" data-end="2744">模型并不会真的去读取文件、执行命令或者查询数据库。</p>
<hr data-start="2746" data-end="2749">
<h2 data-section-id="2swqhr" data-start="2751" data-end="2770">什么是 Observation(观察结果)？</h2>
<p data-start="2772" data-end="2804">Runtime 收到 Action 后，会调用对应的 Tool。</p>
<p data-start="2806" data-end="2809">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>dotnet test</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2836" data-end="2845">执行完成后，返回：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Total Tests: 128
Passed: 127
Failed: 1
NullReferenceException</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;这段返回结果，就是 <strong data-start="2935" data-end="2956">Observation（观察结果）</strong>。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2959" data-end="3005">Runtime 会把 Observation 加入新的 Context，再交给模型继续推理。</p>
<p data-start="3007" data-end="3014">于是模型看到：<strong>测试失败，异常类型是 NullReferenceException。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3054" data-end="3063">它就可以继续思考：<strong>下一步应该查看异常堆栈。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3081" data-end="3097">于是再次生成新的 Action。</p>
<p data-start="3099" data-end="3114">整个过程形成了一个完整的闭环。</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>LLM 思考
      │
      ▼
生成 Action
      │
      ▼
Runtime 执行
      │
      ▼
得到 Observation
      │
      ▼
加入 Context
      │
      ▼
LLM 再次思考</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;Agent 其实正是依靠这种不断循环的方式，逐步完成复杂任务。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="3303" data-end="3306">
<h2 data-section-id="16pr338" data-start="3308" data-end="3331">ReAct：现代 Agent 的基础思想</h2>
<p data-start="3333" data-end="3381">这种"推理—行动—观察"的模式，在学术界被称为 <strong data-start="3357" data-end="3380">ReAct（Reason + Act）</strong>。</p>
<p data-start="3383" data-end="3394">它的核心思想非常简单：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Thought(思考)
↓
Action(行动)
↓
Observation(观察结果)
↓
Thought(思考)
↓
Action(行动)
↓
Observation(观察结果)</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3483" data-end="3492">例如，当用户要求：<strong>帮我定位这个 Bug。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3509" data-end="3517">模型第一次思考：<strong>我需要查看日志。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3531" data-end="3543">于是生成 Action：<strong>Read Log。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3558" data-end="3574">Runtime 执行后返回日志。</p>
<p data-start="3576" data-end="3583">模型继续思考：<strong>日志显示数据库连接失败，需要检查配置文件。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3610" data-end="3626">于是再次生成新的 Action：<strong>Read appsettings.json。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3654" data-end="3686">整个过程中，每一次 Observation 都会影响下一次推理。</p>
<p data-start="3688" data-end="3730">因此，Agent 并不是一次性生成完整方案，而是在不断获取反馈、不断修正自己的判断。</p>
<hr data-start="3732" data-end="3735">
<h2 data-section-id="4wr35a" data-start="3737" data-end="3760">为什么很多产品不再展示 Thought(思考过程)？</h2>
<p data-start="3762" data-end="3792">早期很多 Agent 产品都会直接展示完整的思考过程，例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Thought:
我应该先查看配置文件……
Action:
read_file(appsettings.json)</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3866" data-end="3888">后来，越来越多的商业产品开始隐藏这部分内容。</p>
<p data-start="3890" data-end="3898">原因主要有三个：</p>
<p data-start="3900" data-end="3935">第一，内部推理过程可能包含大量无意义的中间推断，反而增加用户理解成本。</p>
<p data-start="3937" data-end="3975">第二，思考过程可能暴露系统 Prompt、内部规则等敏感信息，存在安全风险。</p>
<p data-start="3977" data-end="4007">第三，不同模型的推理方式并不完全相同，直接展示容易造成误解。</p>
<p data-start="4009" data-end="4024">因此，现在更多产品会展示类似：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>正在分析项目……
正在读取代码……
正在运行测试……
正在生成报告……</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="4078" data-end="4092">而不会完整显示内部推理内容。</p>
<p data-start="4094" data-end="4153">需要说明的是，这并不代表模型没有推理过程，而是这些过程由 Runtime 在后台协调完成，并不一定需要全部呈现给用户。</p>
<hr data-start="4155" data-end="4158">
<h2 data-section-id="8pyqro" data-start="4160" data-end="4191">Action、Observation 与 MCP 的关系</h2>
<p data-start="4193" data-end="4233">在第十一章，我们介绍了 MCP（Model Context Protocol）。</p>
<p data-start="4235" data-end="4249">现在可以把几章内容串联起来。</p>
<p data-start="4251" data-end="4266">当模型生成 Action,比如:<code>查询医院库存</code></p>
<p data-start="4288" data-end="4301">Runtime 首先判断：这是一个 Tool 调用。</p>
<p data-start="4320" data-end="4382">随后通过 MCP Client 找到对应的 MCP Server，由 MCP Server 调用医院库存系统，获取真实数据。</p>
<p data-start="4384" data-end="4391">整个过程如下：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户
↓
LLM
↓
Action
↓
Runtime
↓
MCP Client
↓
MCP Server
↓
医院库存系统
↓
Observation
↓
Runtime
↓
LLM</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="4517" data-end="4522">可以看到：<strong data-start="4524" data-end="4569">LLM 负责决策，Runtime 负责调度，MCP 负责连接，Tool 负责执行。</strong></p>
<p data-start="4571" data-end="4600">四者各司其职，这才能共同组成现代 Agent 的完整执行链路。</p>
<hr data-start="2602" data-end="2605">
<h1 data-section-id="1crli72" data-start="2607" data-end="2631">15.6 Runtime 如何知道任务完成？</h1>
<p data-start="2633" data-end="2650">这是 Runtime 最重要职责。</p>
<p data-start="2652" data-end="2655">例如,模型输出：<code>继续搜索。</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>Runtime：继续。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2701" data-end="2704">模型输出：<code>修改代码。</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>Runtime：继续。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2745" data-end="2748">模型输出：<code>运行测试。</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>Runtime：继续。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2789" data-end="2792">直到模型输出：<code>Task Complete</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>Runtime：停止循环。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2848" data-end="2851">然后给用户返回最终答案。</p>
<p data-start="2860" data-end="2863">所以Runtime不仅负责执行。</p>
<p data-start="2887" data-end="2891">还要负责结束。</p>
<hr data-start="2898" data-end="2901">
<h1 data-section-id="snyh4n" data-start="2903" data-end="2931">15.7 Runtime 如何管理 Context？</h1>
<p data-start="2948" data-end="2951">假设Agent已经运行50 步。</p>
<p data-start="2978" data-end="2986">Context越来越长。</p>
<p data-start="2995" data-end="2999">怎么办？</p>
<p data-start="3001" data-end="3009">Runtime通常会自动进行：Context Management。</p>
<p data-start="3048" data-end="3051">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>历史消息
↓
总结（Summarize）
↓
压缩
↓
保留关键结论
↓
继续执行</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3116" data-end="3119">否则,上下文很快超过模型最大窗口。</p>
<p data-start="3149" data-end="3152">因此Context Management,其实也是 Runtime 工作之一。</p>
<p data-start="3193" data-end="3215">除了总结，现代 Runtime 还可能采用：</p>
<ul data-start="3216" data-end="3295">
<li data-section-id="9s1x0y" data-start="3216" data-end="3246">滑动窗口（Sliding Window）保留最近上下文；</li>
<li data-section-id="1q1zw2i" data-start="3247" data-end="3278">将历史内容写入 Memory，需要时再检索回来（RAG）；</li>
<li data-section-id="11196hg" data-start="3279" data-end="3295">保留关键状态而丢弃中间细节。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3297" data-end="3335">这些策略的目标都是一致的：<strong data-start="3310" data-end="3335">让有限的上下文窗口承载尽可能多的有效信息。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="3337" data-end="3340">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="agpkdw" data-start="62" data-end="88">15.8 Runtime 如何调度 Skill？</h1>
<p data-start="90" data-end="149">上一章我们介绍了 Skill，并提到它可以把某一领域的专业知识、最佳实践和工作规范封装起来，供 Agent 按需使用。</p>
<p data-start="151" data-end="163">那么，一个新的问题来了：<strong data-start="167" data-end="199">Runtime 是如何决定什么时候使用 Skill 的？</strong></p>
<p data-start="201" data-end="227">很多人第一次接触 Skill 时，容易产生一种误解：<strong>Runtime 会把所有 Skill 一次性全部发送给大模型。</strong></p>
<p data-start="264" data-end="287">实际上，现代 Agent 几乎都不会这样设计。</p>
<p data-start="289" data-end="295">原因很简单。</p>
<p data-start="297" data-end="306">假设一个企业拥有：</p>
<ul data-start="308" data-end="429">
<li data-section-id="1cna24l" data-start="308" data-end="320">Java Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="5337qg" data-start="321" data-end="333">.NET Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="jziodp" data-start="334" data-end="348">Python Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="e2s193" data-start="349" data-end="360">SQL Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="1igvuj" data-start="361" data-end="379">Kubernetes Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="14jbbrh" data-start="380" data-end="394">Docker Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="1xiyo4g" data-start="395" data-end="407">产品设计 Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="1x8otl3" data-start="408" data-end="418">测试 Skill</li>
<li data-section-id="164w44d" data-start="419" data-end="429">运维 Skill</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="431" data-end="456">每个 Skill 都包含几千甚至上万 Token。</p>
<p data-start="458" data-end="531">如果启动 Agent 时就把所有 Skill 一次性放入 Context，不仅会迅速耗尽上下文窗口，还会增加推理成本，降低模型对当前任务的关注度。</p>
<p data-start="533" data-end="594">因此，现代 Agent 普遍采用一种更加高效的方式,也就事我们上一章也讲过的——<strong data-start="560" data-end="593">渐进式披露（Progressive Disclosure）</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="596" data-end="599">
<h2 data-section-id="1e34xh8" data-start="601" data-end="636">Runtime 并不会隐藏 Skill，而是按需加载 Skill</h2>
<p data-start="638" data-end="671">这里我们在简单回溯一下，渐进式披露并不是让模型完全不知道有哪些 Skill。</p>
<p data-start="673" data-end="712">通常情况下，Runtime 会先向模型提供每个 Skill 的基础信息，例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Available Skills：
- Java Development
  用于 Java 项目开发与代码分析
- SQL Optimization
  用于数据库设计与 SQL 优化
- Docker Expert
  用于容器构建与部署
- Kubernetes Expert
  用于 Kubernetes 集群运维</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="894" data-end="904">也就是说，模型知道：</p>
<ul data-start="906" data-end="946">
<li data-section-id="5yss6x" data-start="906" data-end="925">当前有哪些 Skill 可以使用；</li>
<li data-section-id="1sgfstx" data-start="926" data-end="946">每个 Skill 大概解决什么问题。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="948" data-end="976">但是，它并不知道每个 Skill 内部包含哪些详细内容。</p>
<p data-start="978" data-end="1001">例如，一个 SQL Skill 里面可能包含：</p>
<ul data-start="1003" data-end="1084">
<li data-section-id="h7q0z1" data-start="1003" data-end="1014">SQL 编码规范；</li>
<li data-section-id="1xbkfjx" data-start="1015" data-end="1024">索引设计原则；</li>
<li data-section-id="r58eet" data-start="1025" data-end="1037">常见慢查询分析方法；</li>
<li data-section-id="rkrxes" data-start="1038" data-end="1053">EXPLAIN 使用技巧；</li>
<li data-section-id="j7hkau" data-start="1054" data-end="1064">数据库最佳实践；</li>
<li data-section-id="1f5bt8z" data-start="1065" data-end="1076">企业内部开发规范；</li>
<li data-section-id="frsks9" data-start="1077" data-end="1084">示例代码。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1086" data-end="1106">这些内容通常有几千甚至上万 Token。</p>
<p data-start="1108" data-end="1157">Runtime 不会在任务开始时全部加载，而是在真正需要的时候，再把完整内容加入 Context。</p>
<hr data-start="1812" data-end="1815">
<h2 data-section-id="13ms855" data-start="1817" data-end="1828">为什么这样设计？</h2>
<p data-start="1830" data-end="1842">这种设计主要有三个优点。</p>
<p data-start="1844" data-end="1865"><strong data-start="1844" data-end="1865">第一，减少 Context 占用。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1867" data-end="1886">绝大多数任务只会涉及少量 Skill。</p>
<p data-start="1888" data-end="1945">例如，一个 SQL 优化任务，完全没有必要同时加载 Java、Docker、Kubernetes 等大量无关知识。</p>
<p data-start="1947" data-end="1975">按需加载能够显著减少 Prompt 长度，提高推理效率。</p>
<hr data-start="1977" data-end="1980">
<p data-start="1982" data-end="1997"><strong data-start="1982" data-end="1997">第二，提高模型注意力。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1999" data-end="2029">模型一次接收的信息越多，真正与当前任务相关的信息比例就越低。</p>
<p data-start="2031" data-end="2077">只加载当前任务需要的 Skill，可以让模型更加聚焦当前问题，减少无关内容对推理过程的干扰。</p>
<hr data-start="2079" data-end="2082">
<p data-start="2084" data-end="2098"><strong data-start="2084" data-end="2098">第三，方便持续维护。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2100" data-end="2119">Skill 通常以独立文件的形式维护。</p>
<p data-start="2121" data-end="2124">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>skills/
├── java.md
├── dotnet.md
├── sql.md
├── docker.md
├── kubernetes.md
└── security.md</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2233" data-end="2280">新增一个 Skill，只需要增加一个新的文件，而不需要修改整个 Agent 的 Prompt。</p>
<p data-start="2282" data-end="2321">企业也可以根据自身业务，不断积累新的 Skill 库，实现知识资产的持续沉淀。</p>
<hr data-start="2323" data-end="2326">
<h2 data-section-id="1gx3ma4" data-start="2328" data-end="2362">Claude Code 与 OpenClaw 都采用了类似思想</h2>
<p data-start="2364" data-end="2393">目前，越来越多的 Agent 产品都采用了类似的设计理念。</p>
<p data-start="2395" data-end="2488">例如 Claude Code 的 Skills，以及 OpenClaw 新版 Skill 规范，都采用了**元数据（Metadata）+ 按需加载（Lazy Loading）**的模式。</p>
<p data-start="2490" data-end="2596">Runtime 首先向模型提供 Skill 的基本信息，例如名称、描述和适用场景；当模型判断某个 Skill 可以帮助完成当前任务时，再由 Runtime 将该 Skill 的完整内容加载到 Context 中。</p>
<p data-start="2598" data-end="2666">这种机制正是前一章介绍的**渐进式披露（Progressive Disclosure）**在 Agent Runtime 中的具体体现。</p>
<hr data-start="3682" data-end="3685">
<h1 data-section-id="zdz00s" data-start="3687" data-end="3720">15.9 Claude Code 为什么可以连续工作几个小时？</h1>
<p data-start="3722" data-end="3726">很多人第一次看到Claude Code。</p>
<p data-start="3753" data-end="3758">都会觉得太神奇了。</p>
<p data-start="3766" data-end="3769">其实Claude模型本身没有连续运行。</p>
<p data-start="3795" data-end="3798">真正连续运行的是Runtime。</p>
<p data-start="3822" data-end="3825">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>读取项目
↓
搜索引用
↓
修改代码
↓
运行测试
↓
失败
↓
再次修改
↓
再次运行
↓
Git Commit</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3912" data-end="3919">Claude模型只是不断思考下一步。</p>
<p data-start="3942" data-end="3945">真正执行Shell、Git、文件、测试的,全部是Runtime。</p>
<p data-start="3991" data-end="3994">所以Claude Code 并不是一个"会写代码的大模型"，而是一个<strong data-start="4028" data-end="4065">由 Runtime 驱动、能够持续执行开发任务的 Agent 系统</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="4298" data-end="4301">
<h1 data-section-id="q6ghxj" data-start="4303" data-end="4330">15.10 Agent Runtime 的完整架构</h1>
<p data-start="4332" data-end="4357">现在，我们终于可以把Agent相关的内容串起来了：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>                    用户目标
                        │
                        ▼
               Agent Runtime
                        │
        ┌───────────────┼────────────────┐
        ▼               ▼                ▼
    Context 管理     Skill Router     Workflow
        │               │                │
        ▼               ▼                ▼
     Memory         加载 Skill        流程控制
                        │
                        ▼
              Prompt / Tool / MCP
                        │
                        ▼
                       LLM
                        │
                 Thought / Action
                        │
                        ▼
                   Observation
                        │
                        └───────────────┐
                                        │
                                   回到 Runtime</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="5226" data-end="5230">请注意：<strong data-start="5232" data-end="5276">Runtime 并不是 LLM 的一部分，而是整个 Agent 系统的控制中心。</strong></p>
<p data-start="5278" data-end="5312">LLM 负责生成下一步行动，Runtime 负责让这些行动真正发生。</p>
<hr data-start="5314" data-end="5317">
<h1 data-section-id="1mm2zvm" data-start="5319" data-end="5325">本章总结</h1>
<p data-start="5327" data-end="5343">这一章，我们回答了六个关键问题：</p>
<ol data-start="5345" data-end="5789">
<li data-section-id="v5cnrl" data-start="5345" data-end="5401"><strong data-start="5348" data-end="5370">什么是 Agent Runtime？</strong>
<ul data-start="5374" data-end="5401">
<li data-section-id="etz88p" data-start="5374" data-end="5401">它是智能体的运行时系统，负责协调所有组件完成任务。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="1u13vnv" data-start="5403" data-end="5460"><strong data-start="5406" data-end="5426">Runtime 为什么必不可少？</strong>
<ul data-start="5430" data-end="5460">
<li data-section-id="13q2pp6" data-start="5430" data-end="5460">因为 LLM 不会主动调用工具、管理状态或持续执行任务。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="vjvumz" data-start="5462" data-end="5529"><strong data-start="5465" data-end="5484">Agent 是如何持续工作的？</strong>
<ul data-start="5488" data-end="5529">
<li data-section-id="mb47ib" data-start="5488" data-end="5529">Runtime 通过事件循环不断驱动"推理 → 执行 → 观察 → 再推理"。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="kw0cj7" data-start="5531" data-end="5614"><strong data-start="5534" data-end="5563">Action 与 Observation 是什么？</strong>
<ul data-start="5567" data-end="5614">
<li data-section-id="19rst61" data-start="5567" data-end="5614">LLM 输出 Action，Runtime 执行并返回 Observation，形成闭环。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="s21stt" data-start="5616" data-end="5684"><strong data-start="5619" data-end="5639">Runtime 还负责哪些工作？</strong>
<ul data-start="5643" data-end="5684">
<li data-section-id="kn0b67" data-start="5643" data-end="5684">包括 Context 管理、Skill 路由、Memory 检索、任务终止等。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="x3lxl7" data-start="5686" data-end="5789"><strong data-start="5689" data-end="5732">为什么 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 看起来越来越像？</strong>
<ul data-start="5736" data-end="5789">
<li data-section-id="cr3yvc" data-start="5736" data-end="5789">因为它们虽然产品形态不同，但 Runtime 的核心思想正在逐渐收敛：都是围绕"持续完成任务"来设计。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

</div>
